description: This file contains integration tests for the DELETE endpoint of catalog items in the API, verifying behavior with valid and invalid IDs using an admin user token.

classes.name: DeleteCatalogItemEndpointTest
classes.description: Test class for the DELETE catalog item endpoint, containing test methods to check responses for valid and invalid IDs.

methods.name: ReturnsSuccessGivenValidIdAndAdminUserToken
methods.description: Tests that deleting a catalog item with a valid ID and admin token returns a success response and status 'Deleted'.

methods.name: ReturnsNotFoundGivenInvalidIdAndAdminUserToken
methods.description: Tests that deleting a catalog item with an invalid ID returns a NotFound status code.
